properties.content: Question: netflix monthly cost Answer: Netflix has three monthly subscription plans: Standard with Ads ($7.99), Standard ($17.99), and Premium ($24.99). These prices are accurate as of May 2025. The Standard with Ads plan includes ads and limits streaming to two supported devices at a time. properties.formattedContent:
Question: netflix monthly cost

Answer: Netflix has three monthly subscription plans: Standard with Ads ($7.99), Standard ($17.99), and Premium ($24.99). These prices are accurate as of May 2025. The Standard with Ads plan includes ads and limits streaming to two supported devices at a time. The Standard plan is ad-free with two simultaneous streams, while the Premium plan offers four simultaneous streams and higher video quality according to NerdWallet.

3.fact: The Standard plan is ad-free with two simultaneous streams.
3.explanation: The Standard plan is ad-free and supports streaming on two devices at the same time, as detailed in Netflix's official documentation and corroborated by news sources.
